facts.text: Through the Richmond Guarantee, every continuing undergraduate student in the School of Arts & Sciences, Jepson School of Leadership Studies, and Robins School of Business is eligible to receive one fellowship of up to $5,500 for a summer internship or faculty-mentored research project.
Beginning in fall 2025, Richmond's Promise to Virginia funds 100% of the cost of tuition, housing, and food for qualified Virginia students whose parental income is $75,000 or less.
